::: {.key-facts}
At the 2022 census, 155,851 people lived in County Wicklow, up 9.4% on 2016. It had the 11th largest population of the 26 counties.

Its population in 2022 was 124% of its population in 1841, the last census before the Great Famine.

In 2025, the average monthly rent on a new tenancy in County Wicklow was €1,730, the second highest of the 26 counties.
:::

## More about County Wicklow

- In 2024, disposable income per person in County Wicklow was €30,235, the 8th highest of the 26 counties. [See the map](/charts/economy-income-map.html)
- In 2025, the average price paid for a home in County Wicklow was €507,100, the second highest of the 26 counties. [See the map](/charts/housing-prices-map.html)
- In 2025, 8.8 new homes were completed for every 1,000 people in County Wicklow, the 5th highest rate of the 26 counties. [See the map](/charts/housing-completions-map.html)
- At the 2022 census, 24% of households in County Wicklow rented their home, the 15th highest share of the 26 counties. [See the map](/charts/housing-renting-map.html)
- At the 2022 census, 17% of people living in County Wicklow were born outside Ireland, the 19th highest share of the 26 counties. [See the map](/charts/migration-born-abroad-map.html)
- At the 2022 census, 39% of people aged 3 and over in County Wicklow said they could speak Irish, the 18th highest share of the 26 counties. [See the map](/charts/irish-language-speakers-map.html)
- At the 2022 census, 41% of people at work in County Wicklow worked from home for at least part of the week, the second highest share of the 26 counties. [See the map](/charts/economy-work-from-home-map.html)
- At the 2022 census, 72% of people travelling to work in County Wicklow went by car, the third lowest share of the 26 counties. [See the map](/charts/economy-car-to-work-map.html)
- Half of people in County Wicklow live more than 1.3 km by road from a GP, the 23rd furthest of the 26 counties. [See the map](/charts/health-distance-gp-map.html)
- Half of people in County Wicklow live more than 28.3 km by road from a hospital emergency department, the 10th furthest of the 26 counties. [See the map](/charts/health-distance-emergency-department-map.html)
- Forests and woodland covered 20.7% of County Wicklow in 2021, the highest share of the 26 counties. [See the map](/charts/environment-forest-map.html)
